sources.text: Built API observability systems using latency histograms, distributed tracing, and endpoint error-rate dashboards.
Email drafts require human review. The owner edits the prepared message and clicks Send manually in Gmail.
Workflow checkpoints preserve completed steps, original goals, tool results, and remaining budgets across process restarts.
Uploaded PDF originals live in a private storage bucket. Only the authenticated Python backend retrieves their contents.
Instruction following uses Grok 4.3. Tool reasoning uses Grok 4.20. Evidence analysis uses the multi-agent research model.
A contact's explicit opt-out blocks future outreach even if older relationship facts expire.
Brave discovers public website URLs. The browser reads page text and retains the supporting source address and retrieval date.
Tomatoes require sunlight, regular irrigation, fertile soil, and protection from frost.
Bread dough rises when yeast ferments sugar. Kneading develops gluten and improves the loaf structure.
Saturn has prominent icy rings. Its largest moon Titan has a dense atmosphere.
Railway tickets can be reserved in advance. Travelers should check station departure times.
A violin has four strings. The player changes pitch by pressing strings against the fingerboard.
